name: Integration
description: An account Sektar keeps in sync (mail, bank, calendar, hours): what the user asked for, what the reconciler on the runner built for it, the generation it committed, and what it found on its last check.

global.schema:
type IntegrationState {
  "What comes in; fixed by INITIALIZE. Null until then"
  kind: IntegrationKind
  "How it comes in: a provider adapter id (google-calendar, gmail, imap). Null until INITIALIZE"
  provider: String
  "Settings only this provider has, checked by its adapter"
  providerOptions: Unknown
  "What the user asked for; written from the app"
  intent: IntegrationIntent!
  "What the reconciler built for the intent"
  resources: IntegrationResources!
  "The last intent generation the reconciler committed"
  applied: IntegrationApplied
  "The reconciler's last pass: what it found"
  check: IntegrationCheck
  "A check asked for from the app (Check now)"
  checkRequest: IntegrationCheckRequest
  "What the reconciler put back, latest first, at most 20"
  fixes: [IntegrationFix!]!
  "The reactor that fetches and holds the token; null: the switchboard that owns this drive, until it claims it"
  runner: IntegrationRunner
}

enum IntegrationKind {
  EMAIL
  TRANSACTIONS
  CALENDAR
  TIME_TRACKING
}

type IntegrationIntent {
  "Raised by every change to the intent; the reconciler commits a generation"
  generation: Int!
  "An existing connection the user picked; null: the reconciler makes one (resources.connectionId)"
  connectionId: PHID
  "The drive the imported documents land in; null: the kind's default drive"
  targetDriveId: PHID
  "What Sektar may do with the account: only read, or read and write. Null: not chosen (read only)"
  access: IntegrationAccess
  "What to bring in, per kind and provider-neutral"
  source: IntegrationSource
  live: LiveIntent!
  backfill: BackfillIntent!
  "An archived integration's workflows are archived; its data stays"
  archived: Boolean!
}

enum IntegrationAccess {
  "See, never change: the provider's read-only permissions"
  READ
  "Also add and change; never delete"
  READ_WRITE
}

union IntegrationSource = CalendarSource | EmailSource

type CalendarSource {
  "The calendars picked; empty while allOwned"
  calendars: [CalendarRef!]!
  "Every calendar the account owns, including ones added later"
  allOwned: Boolean!
}

type CalendarRef {
  "The provider's calendar id"
  id: String!
  name: String
}

type EmailSource {
  mailbox: String!
  folders: [String!]!
}

type LiveIntent {
  "The Live updates switch"
  enabled: Boolean!
  "How often to check for what is new"
  every: Interval!
}

type Interval {
  value: Int!
  unit: IntervalUnit!
}

enum IntervalUnit {
  MINUTES
  HOURS
  DAYS
}

type BackfillIntent {
  "The Backfill switch: the backfill workflow on or off"
  enabled: Boolean!
  "How much per run, and how often; null: the provider's default"
  batch: BackfillBatch
  "In the order they run"
  items: [BackfillItem!]!
  "Make active; null: the first unfinished item"
  pinnedId: OID
}

type BackfillBatch {
  size: Int!
  every: Interval!
}

type BackfillItem {
  id: OID!
  "e.g. 2023 to today"
  label: String!
  "Any backfill document type with an adapter"
  documentType: String!
  "Null until the reconciler has created it from the request"
  documentId: PHID
  "How to create it; null when an existing document was attached"
  request: BackfillRequest
}

union BackfillRequest = DateRangeBackfill | FolderListBackfill

type DateRangeBackfill {
  from: DateTime!
  to: DateTime!
  "The size of one slice"
  stepSeconds: Int!
  "Which end it starts from; null: BACKWARD, newest first (the queue's own default)"
  direction: BackfillDirection
}

enum BackfillDirection {
  "From the range's start towards its end: oldest first"
  FORWARD
  "From the range's end back towards its start: newest first"
  BACKWARD
}

type FolderListBackfill {
  folders: [String!]!
}

type IntegrationResources {
  "The connection the reconciler made, when the intent names none"
  connectionId: PHID
  liveWorkflowId: PHID
  backfillWorkflowId: PHID
  "The backfill item the backfill workflow points at now"
  pluggedItemId: OID
}

type IntegrationApplied {
  generation: Int!
  at: DateTime!
  host: String
}

type IntegrationCheck {
  at: DateTime!
  host: String
  "The intent generation this pass evaluated"
  generation: Int!
  "The check request it answered, if any"
  request: OID
  issues: [IntegrationIssue!]!
}

type IntegrationIssue {
  "Plugin-defined, e.g. NEEDS_SIGN_IN, LIVE_WORKFLOW_MISSING, COVERAGE_GAP"
  code: String!
  severity: IssueSeverity!
  "The workflow, backfill or connection it is about"
  subject: PHID
  "In the user's words"
  message: String!
  "False: only the user can fix it (Reconnect)"
  fixable: Boolean!
  since: DateTime!
}

enum IssueSeverity {
  INFO
  WARNING
  BLOCKING
}

type IntegrationCheckRequest {
  id: OID!
  requestedAt: DateTime!
  requestedBy: String
}

type IntegrationFix {
  at: DateTime!
  code: String!
  subject: PHID
  "Put back: ..."
  message: String!
}

type IntegrationRunner {
  reactorId: String!
  "The machine's name, e.g. Wouter's PC"
  label: String
}

operations.name: REQUEST_CHECK
RECORD_RUNNER
operations.reducer:
if (state.runner && state.runner.reactorId !== action.input.reactorId) throw new RunnerTakenError(`${state.runner.reactorId} runs this integration`);
state.runner = { reactorId: action.input.reactorId, label: action.input.label ?? null };

operations.name: RECORD_RESOURCES
RECORD_BACKFILL_DOCUMENT

input IntegrationIssueInput {
  code: String!

  subject: PHID
  message: String!
  fixable: Boolean!
  since: DateTime!
}

input IntegrationFixInput {
  at: DateTime!
  code: String!
  subject: PHID
  message: String!
}

input RecordCheckInput {
  at: DateTime!
  host: String
  "The intent generation this pass evaluated"
  generation: Int!
  "The check request it answered, if any"
  request: OID
  issues: [IntegrationIssueInput!]!
  fixes: [IntegrationFixInput!]!
  "Everything the reconciler can do for this generation is done"
  committed: Boolean!
}
